entries.title: Metal: Hellsinger
entries.definitive_edition: Metal: Hellsinger Complete Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build for the main route; use native VR hardware only for the VR adaptation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for the main route; headset-dependent for VR.

primary.why: The Windows PC Complete Edition includes the base game plus Dream of the Beast, Purgatory, and Essential Hits Pack DLC while offering the best fidelity, latency control, and capture route. Console and VR releases are valid alternate access routes but do not add exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Metal: Hellsinger Complete Edition on Steam or the Xbox/PC storefront for Windows PC. Use the VR version only if you specifically want the VR adaptation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Complete Edition bundles the base game with Dream of the Beast, Purgatory, and Essential Hits Pack. Metal: Hellsinger VR is a VR adaptation, not a replacement for the flat Complete Edition route.
